item.attuned.swift_focus.lore: Tuned to the wind's own hurry.
item.attuned.swift_focus.lore2: The ground forgets to hold you.
item.attuned.vital_focus.lore: A borrowed pulse, warm against the chest.
item.attuned.vital_focus.lore2: It beats whether you ask it to or not.

item.attuned.iron_focus.lore2: Blows arrive to find the matter long settled.
item.attuned.leap_focus.lore: Up is just another direction, properly asked.
item.attuned.leap_focus.lore2: Gravity hears you out before it answers.
item.attuned.edge_focus.lore: Sharper than the steel; the steel only follows.
item.attuned.edge_focus.lore2: It parts the thought before the blade.

item.attuned.frenzy_focus.lore2: Patience was always the slower blade.

item.attuned.cinder_focus.lore2: It waits for flame, then bites.

item.attuned.drift_focus.lore2: However far the fall, you land like a leaf.
item.attuned.tide_focus.effect: Lets you breathe underwater and swim more freely.
item.attuned.galespur_focus.lore: A bridle for the wind itself.
item.attuned.galespur_focus.lore2: Every road arrives sooner beneath you.
item.attuned.galespur_focus.effect: Doubles the speed of living mounts you ride.
item.attuned.rainstep_focus.lore2: Wet stone turns willing beneath you.
item.attuned.rainstep_focus.effect: Move faster through rain and wet ground.
item.attuned.emberward_focus.lore2: You pass through; the fire stays behind.
item.attuned.emberward_focus.effect: Grants immunity to fire and lava.
item.attuned.anchor_focus.lore: A small weight against the world's shove.
item.attuned.anchor_focus.lore2: Set your stance, and the blow loses interest.
item.attuned.anchor_focus.effect: Gain knockback resistance while sneaking or blocking.
item.attuned.aegis_focus.lore: A held breath, made into armor.
item.attuned.aegis_focus.lore2: The first wound spends itself on nothing.
item.attuned.nightgaze_focus.lore: The dark does not lift. You stop minding it.
item.attuned.nightgaze_focus.lore2: Every shadow keeps its shape for you.
item.attuned.hearth_focus.lore: Coals remember the shape of home.
item.attuned.hearth_focus.lore2: Rest close enough, and warmth answers.
item.attuned.hearth_focus.effect: Near lit campfires, slowly recover health while well fed.
item.attuned.lantern_focus.lore: A little flame with a watchful eye.
item.attuned.lantern_focus.lore2: The dark keeps fewer secrets when carried.
item.attuned.lantern_focus.effect: Holding a torch or lantern in darkness reveals nearby visible threats.
item.attuned.delver_focus.lore: Stone remembers it was once dust.
item.attuned.delver_focus.effect: Grants Haste for faster block breaking.
item.attuned.lodestone_focus.lore2: Drop what you will; the ground hands it back.
item.attuned.lodestone_focus.effect: Pulls nearby dropped items toward you.
item.attuned.thornward_focus.lore: To strike the attuned is to be answered.
item.attuned.thornward_focus.lore2: Every blow keeps a copy for the sender.
item.attuned.thornward_focus.effect: Reflects 25% of melee damage back at attackers.
item.attuned.leech_focus.lore2: Their warmth was only ever on loan.
item.attuned.leech_focus.effect: Heals you for 20% of the melee damage you deal.

item.attuned.attunement_journal.lore: A field guide for the newly attuned.
item.attuned.attunement_journal.lore2: Its margins smell faintly of amethyst dust.

journal.attuned.title: Attunement Journal
journal.attuned.screen.title: Attunement Codex
journal.attuned.screen.subtitle: Foci, pacts, altar craft
journal.attuned.line1: Foci work only while equipped and inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.line2: Slot order is priority: higher slots wake first when capacity is tight.
journal.attuned.line3: Fury beats Bastion, Bastion beats Zephyr, and Zephyr beats Fury.
journal.attuned.line4: Mixing active affinities creates Discord: more damage dealt and taken.
journal.attuned.line5: Three matching Foci can awaken a Pact. Four committed Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.
journal.attuned.line6: Bind shards at an Attunement Altar, and craft four fragments into one shard.
journal.attuned.line7: The Unseen reward stillness, shadows, and openings rather than raw force.
journal.attuned.line8: Foci and shard fragments are found through vanilla loot, including Lootr-style chests.
journal.attuned.page1:
Attunement Journal

Equip Foci in the side slots of your inventory.

A Focus only works while it is awake inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.page2:
Priority

Higher Focus slots wake first.

If your total cost is too high, lower slots go dormant before higher slots.
journal.attuned.page3:
Capacity

Capacity is your build budget.

Bind Attunement Shards at an Altar to raise it, up to the server's cap.
journal.attuned.page4:
Affinities

Fury beats Bastion.
Bastion beats Zephyr.
Zephyr beats Fury.

Neutral Foci fit any build.
journal.attuned.page5:
Discord

Using two or more active affinities creates Discord.

You deal more damage, but you also take more damage.
journal.attuned.page6:
Pacts

Three active Foci of one affinity can awaken a Pact.

Pacts reward committing to a lane instead of wearing every trick at once.
journal.attuned.page7:
Apex

Four committed Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.

Build combat resonance to wake the capstone moment.
journal.attuned.page8:
Shards and Altars

Four Shard Fragments craft into one Attunement Shard.

Place a shard in the Altar and press Bind.
journal.attuned.page9:
The Unseen

These Foci favor quiet movement, smoke, veils, and ambush openings.

They are a faction, not a fourth affinity.
journal.attuned.page10:
Finding Foci

Attuned adds Foci and shard fragments to vanilla loot: structures, fishing treasure, archaeology, and trial rewards.

Lootr chests use the same chest tables.
journal.attuned.page11:
First Builds

At capacity 4, keep it plain.

Swift and Leap make a travel kit. Harvest and Nightgaze make a calm work kit. Vital can stand alone.
journal.attuned.page12:
Capacity 6

Try Iron and Emberward for a Bastion guard.

Edge and Frenzy favor Fury raids.

Swift, Leap, and Softstep suit Zephyr roads.
journal.attuned.page13:
Adjusting

If a Focus sleeps, move it to a higher slot or lower the cost.

Bind shards for more capacity. Neutral Foci are easiest to fit.
journal.attuned.page14:
Altar Memory

Altars bind shards and return anything left inside when closed.

Their glow remembers the last bound affinity. Candles and amethyst only change the ritual's look.
journal.attuned.page15:
Pyresworn Pact

Three active Fury Foci awaken Pyresworn.

Melee hits can ignite foes. Try Edge, Frenzy, and another Fury Focus.
journal.attuned.page16:
Stoneheart Pact

Three active Bastion Foci awaken Stoneheart.

Incoming damage is dulled. Try Iron, Emberward, and Vital.
journal.attuned.page17:
Windrunner Pact

Three active Zephyr Foci awaken Windrunner.

You sprint faster and step over short rises. Try Swift, Leap, and Softstep.
journal.attuned.page18:
Untethered Pact

One active Focus from Fury, Bastion, and Zephyr awakens Untethered.

You hit affinity-bearing foes harder, but the pattern is harder to hold.
journal.attuned.page19:
Discord

Discord is a risky stance, not a mistake.

Mixed affinities raise damage dealt and taken. Use it for short aggressive fights, then settle into a Pact when you want stability.
journal.attuned.page20:
The Altar of Reweaving

Some altars do not deepen the soul's room.

They turn an old pattern until it catches the light differently.
journal.attuned.page21:
What Reweaving Is Not

Reweaving does not make a Focus louder, stronger, or freer.

It changes the way a bound pattern is remembered.
journal.attuned.page22:
Altar Memory

Every altar keeps a trace of what was last bound there.

Reweaving listens to that trace before it answers.
journal.attuned.page23:
The Radiant

The Radiant keep vows in light.

They believe power is safest when named, witnessed, and remembered.
journal.attuned.page24:
The Unseen

The Unseen keep masks and hidden roads.

They believe power is safest when no one can claim or own it.
journal.attuned.page25:
Witness and Veil

Radiant and Unseen oppose each other like lantern and shadow.

Both exist to keep attunement from becoming careless.
journal.attuned.page26:
The Seafarers

The Seafarers carry fragments, journals, and half-remembered routes from shore to shore.

They trade in guidance, not conquest.
journal.attuned.page27:
Tide Records

A Seafarer's best map is return.

Where a wreck sank. Where a bell was heard. Where a shard washed clean.
journal.attuned.page28:
Reading the HUD

The marks near your hand are not commands from the altar.

They are the shape your active Foci make when the world pushes back.
item.attuned.stormcall_focus.lore: The sky lends its voice; you need only run.

item.attuned.gravebind_focus.lore2: You left before the door could close.

item.attuned.bloodfury_focus.effect: Attack speed climbs as your health falls, up to 40% faster.
item.attuned.voidstep_focus.lore: Space folds where you will it.

item.attuned.harvest_focus.effect: Nearby crops ripen faster while you stand among them.

item.attuned.tremor_focus.lore2: Not a map. Only a hunch with weight.
item.attuned.tremor_focus.effect: Mining stone may hint that ore is somewhere nearby.
item.attuned.beacon_focus.lore2: Lost is a direction, not a place.
item.attuned.beacon_focus.effect: Aims a held compass at your last bed.

item.attuned.waystone_focus.effect: A single held compass points toward your last death while active.
item.attuned.softstep_focus.lore: A step so careful the dust keeps sleeping.
item.attuned.softstep_focus.lore2: The path notices only after you have gone.
